title: Got it as a gift, I do not like it.
text: Got it as a gift, I do not like it.. The temperature settings are not clear marked you have to keep eying it and guessing and hoping you're right, no indication on the dial that you are set on the right temperature: for example the numbers marked are 375 then straight to 475, not really accurate first time we cooked our pizza it came out raw at the center, 2nd time it was perfectly cooked at the center but the edges were burnt, it's just not an accurate oven. You also have to rotate the pizza halfway through cooking or else the far side in will burn even more and rotating it while it's sitting on that huge and heavy stone is a pain in the ass, the oven is also too small to handle while burning hot. Not a good product please look elsewhere.

product_metadata.title: HomeCraft Convection Pizza Oven, Fits 12-Inch Pizza, Built In Timer, Adjustable Temperature Controls, Includes Pizza Stone, Wire Rack and Crumb Tray, Black With Stainless Steel Handles
features: LARGE CAPACITY: 15-Liters with non-stick interior, pizza bump in the back allows you to cook up to a full 12” pizza (13.35” x 13.62” x 6.02)
1300-WATTS CONVECTION COOKING POWER:  This pizza oven provides the cooking power needed to quickly cook your favorite pizza​
VERSATILE: Great for making frozen pizzas, homemade pizzas, keto-friendly cauliflower crust pizzas, and more.

MODERN and ELEGANT: Black with glass door and stainless-steel handle for a stylish, elegant look that will look good in any setting​

In addition, easily keep track of cooking time by using the built-in 40-minute timer that elicits an audible ding when done. With an upgraded appearance and its stainless-steel handle, it is sure to compliment any setting.
